question: Lowooza ku mbeera eno: Omusomesa ow’abaana abato alina ennyiriri bbiri ez’amatofaali nga zirimu omuwendo gwe gumu, naye ng'olumu lusobola okulabika ng'olusingako obuwanvu kubanga entegeka yalwo ya mabanga.  Omu ku baana ajja eri omusomesa n’agamba nti, ‘Nyabo, olunyiriri luno lulina ematafali mangi okusinga olulala.’ Okusinziira ku ndowooza ya J. Piaget, kiki omwana ky'aba alowooza?
answer_a: Okutunuulira ekintu ng'okyesigamya ku kintu ekimu

question: Omwana, ng’atambula ne kitaawe mu nkuba, atunula waggulu mu ggulu n’alaba ebire ng’agamba: ‘Ebire byeraliikirivu, y’ensonga lwaki bikaaba.’ Okusinziira ku Jean Piaget mu nkola ye ey’obwongo, kiki ekiraga endowooza y’omwana eno?

Ekibinja kya abaana abato aboobulenzi na aboobuwala nga basiiga ekifanaayi ekikubiddwa ku kisenge ekiri mu luggya lwe essomero.Fabian ategeeza omusomesa nti tayagala kusiiga kubanga langi ya pinka ye yali esigaddewo ate langi ya bawala. Omusomesa amutegeza nti langi buli omu teriko balenzi oba bawala ,nti era ageezeko okugiisiigisa nga abasiizi we bakola. Bwe weteegereza mbeera ki omusomesa gyakulaakulanya okusinziira ku kitangaziddwa?
answer_c: Obuntu bw'omuntu obukwata ku by'okukwatagana kw'abantu ng'abaami n'abakyala

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Omusomesa ategeka omulimu oguyitibwa 'omutongole ow'olwaleero', ogw'omwana, buli lunaku, okugabana n'abayizi banne byayagala, ebigendererwa bye, n'eby'amasanyu bye yayagalira ddala okuyita mu bifaananyi, ebijukizo , ebizannyisibwa, n'enjogera ezirimu obumanyirivu. Musingi ki ogw'obusomesa oguliwo mu mbeera eyo waggulu?

Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okuna ng’ali n’abayizi be ku ddembe ly’abaana abalaga embeera eno: “Anita yakubwa omutwe ennyo bwe yagwa okuva ku siriidi ng’azannya ne banne mu luggya lw’essomero. Oluvannyuma lw’akabenje, Anita yatwalibwa mangu omusomesa we mu ddwaaliro, gy’afunira obujjanjabi obwetaagisa.” Oluvannyuma, omusomesa asaba abayizi okutegeera eddembe Anita ly’akozesa mu mbeera eyo era oluvannyuma, okuleeta embeera endala omutwalirwa eddembe lye limu. Ku biraga ebiri wammanga, kiraga ki ekikulu okukebereza okuyiga kw’abayizi mu mulimu ogwo omusomesa gw’aleese?
answer_b: Balaga eby'obuyinza bye bakozesa mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo nga bakozesa eby'okulabirako ebyanamadala.
answer_c: Bakola endowooza ku bukulu bw’okukola dduyiro n’okukuuma eddembe lyabwe
answer_d: Bategeera ebiseera ebyo eddembe ly'abaana we lityoboolebwa.

question: Omukugu mu by'enjigiriza ateekateeka omulimu abalenzi n'abawala mu kibinja kye mwe bajja okukyalirwa ekibiina ky'abaana abasoma ekibiina ekisooka okuva mu ssomero. Bwe banaatuuka, buli mwana omuto ajja kutuula okumpi n'omwana ow'ekibiina ekisooka, era bajja kukubirizibwa okumanyagana nga banyumya. Oluvannyuma, bajja kusiiga ekifaananyi nga bali wamu era bagende mu luggya bazannye. Ku nkomerero, bajja kwekubagiza mu kibinja kyonna ku ebyo bye baayitamu nga bali wamu. Mu nsonga z’obuyigiriza eziddirira, nsonga ki ey’obuyigiriza ekulizibwaamu nnyo mu bumanyirivu buno obw’okuyiga?

Okusinziira ku muzannyo ng’ekikolwa eky’omubiri ekitegekeddwa, myaka ki omuntu weetaaga okutuukiriza ekimu ku bintu ebikulu eby’omuzannyo, nga kino kiba kwenyigira ng’omuntu kinnoomu okusinga okukolera awamu?

Bawandiisi ki wammanga abateesa mu ndowooza yabwe eyo kukulakulanya ebyuuma ebikozesa amasanyalaze,Emitendera ena nga bigwa muttuluba lye bakola nga bikyamufu nebyo ebikiikiriddwa okuva 0 mpaka ku myaka 12?
Ki ku bigambo bino wammanga ekiraga enkolagana entuufu wakati w’okukulaakulanya okwagala n’enkolagana ey’oluvannyuma; okusinziira ku ndowooza ya Bowlby(Bowlby's theory)?
answer_a: Abantu abakula nga balina enkolagana ey’okulusegere n’omukuzza atali nnyabwe baba tebasobola kuba na nkolagana nnungi na balala.
answer_b: Abantu abalina ababakuza(omukuza) abakyusa mu ngeri gye babafaako mu myaka gyabwe egy'obuto batera okukula nga balina obwetwaze mu nneewulira zaabwe.
answer_c: Abantu abataalina nkolagana nnungi mu buto bwabwe basobola okuzimba enkolagana ennungi naye batera okuba nga tebeesiga balala.
answer_d: Abantu abataakulaakulanya mikwano(nkolagana) mu myaka egy'obuto , batera okunoonya obuyambi n'okubeera okumpi n'abalala, wamu era n'okwoleka enneewulira, ka zibe nnungi oba mbi.

question:
Enkola eno yakozesebwa nnyo mu kusomesa abaana abato nga bayita mu kunoonyereza ku bintu eby’enjawulo ebyakolebwa abantu abakulu nga bakozesa ebintu eby’enjawulo gamba ng’ebyawandiikidwa, ebifaananyi, ne vidiyo. Abaana nabo beenyigira mu kunoonyereza kuno nga boogera ku byo baagala, enkaayana zaabwe, ebyabatuukako, n’embeera endala nnyingi eziyinza okuyambako okusalawo ku nsonga z’okusomesa era nga kiyamba okukulaakulanya engeri zaabwe.
Nteekateeka y’ebisomesebwa ki eyogerwako mu mutundu ogwo waggulu?

Omusomesa mu kibiina ky'abaana abato asomera akabinja ke ak'abaana abalenzi n'abawala olugero 'Ennyenje Enjala Ennyo', balukubaganyaako ebirowoozo, oluvannyuma n'abagamba bakole omulimu ogw'okwanjula ebikwata ku mmere ennungi n'embi n'ebivaamu. Okukola kino, agabanya ekibiina mu bubinja bubiri obutono: akamu kajja kukola olupapula oluliko ebifaananyi by'emmere ennungi n'akalala, olupapula oluliko ebifaananyi by'emmere embi. Okumaliriza, banjula wamu era bakubaganya ebirowoozo ku by'ebafunye.


Kuyiga ki omulimu guno gwe gukutiriza okusinga mu baana?
answer_b: Okwogerezeganya no' kukubaganya ebirowoozo no'kusalawokwabwe ne bannabwe

question: Ekibinja ky’abaana abakulu mu nasale kirimu abaana kkumi. Bonna batambula n’obuvumu era banyumirwa ebikolwa eby’okutambula. Batandise okulaga okwagala mu bisoomooza gamba ng’okutikka, okukweka, okutuuma, n’okugatta ebintu. N’olwekyo, omusomesa ateekateeka okukwata ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga bino wammanga: “Wegezeemu n'ebintu nga bakola ku mbeera eziriwo ddala, gamba ng’okutuuka ku bintu, okunyiga obutambi ku byuma ebivuga, okuggya ebizannyisibwa mu bintu bye biterekebwamu, okukung’aanya ebintu, n’ebirala” era “Okulaga okwagala n’okumatira nga batambula awatali buzibu mu mbeera eza bulijjo n’emizannyo”. Nga twetegerezza empisa z’ekibiina ky’abaana bano, nkola ki ey’okuyiga eyinza okusobozesa omusomesa okukwata ku bigendererwa ebyo ebirondeddwa?
answer_a: Omuzannyo ogw'okukebera: abaana bakebera, bakwatakwata era bagatta ebintu, nga bazuula ensi ku sipiidi yaabwe.
answer_b: OEkkubo ly'amasannyalaze: abaana bamaliriza omusinde ogw'ebizibu eby'enjawulo, nga bagoberera enteekateeka entongole.
answer_c: Akabbo k'ebyabugagga: abaana bakebera nga batuula okwetooloola akabba akajjuziddwa ebintu ebya bulijjo n'ebyo ebirondeddwa
answer_d: Ekifo ky'ebyamazina: abaana bazannya, batambulatambula era bakolagana n'ebintu ebirabika obulungi ebiterekeddwa mu kifo.

question: Omusomesa yetaaga okulonda ebikozesebwa bya tekinologiya ebinayanguyiza empuliziganya mu bamemba mu buli kibinja buli omu naye; akkiriza okugabanya n'okulongoosa ebiwandiiko mu biseera ebiriwo; wamu n'okuteekawo emirimu n'okuwa buli memba mu buli kibinja. Ku bikozesebwa ebiweereddwa wammanga eriwa esinga okutuukiriza ebisaanyizo by'omusomesa.
answer_a: Akataffeesi ak'omukutu ogwa kompyuta akagabanyizibwako emikutu gya yintaneeti nga Symbaloo
answer_b: Enkola y'okukozesa okuteesa ebirowoozo nga Stormboard
answer_c: Enkola y'okutereka ebipapula ku intaneeti nga Google Drive
answer_d: Omukutu ogw'okukyusa endowooza nga okukozesa ebifaananyi, okufaanana nga Marqueed

question: Soma okunnyonnyola kuno wammanga: Emu ku ndowooza ze ezisinga obukulu mu by’enjigiriza y’enjogera y’Obumanyirivu Obutabaganyiziddwa (Mediated Learning Experience - MLE), obukyusakyusa mu bwongo bw’omuntu mwe busibuka. MLE kitegeeza omutindo gw’enkolagana y’omuntu n’obwetooloole bwe, omuli okunnyonnyola engeri obwongo gye bukola ng’ekivaamu okusaasaanya obuwangwa. Okusinziira ku ndowooza eno, enkola y’okutabaganya etwalibwa ng’eyongera ku busobozi bw’omuntu okutuuka ku njigiriza ey’omugaso, ng’okutegeera nti okuyita mu yo, omuntu asobola okukyusa enjigiriza etuukiddwaako mu mbeera enjawulo era n’asobola okugikozesa mu mbeera oba embeera endala, ng’ekubiriza okuggya obumanyirivu bw’omuntu ku bubwe mu njigiriza empya. Mu bawandiisi abalondeddwa wammanga, ani alowoozebwa okuba n’enjogera eno ku nkola y’okuyigiriza n’okuyiga eyannyonnyolwa mu mutundu oguweddeko?

Omusomesa w'ekibiina ekyokusatu, mu kitundu ekikwata ku ddembe ly'abaana, yalonda ekitundu kino okuva mu lugero Omuwala Ataalina Erinnya, olwa Saúl Schkolnik, okutandika okukolera awamu n'abayizi be ku ddembe ly'okumanya ekyo ky'oli: Edda ennyo,waaliwo omuwala ataali na linnya lyonna. Si nti yalina erinnya eryewuunyisa, oba nga okulyogera kizibu, oba erimu ku mannya ago amakadde ennyo, oba mpozzi ery'amawanga... Nedda! Yali talina linnya lyonna. Eky'amazima kiri nti, omuntu bw'aba nga ye Maria era omuntu n'ayita: —Maria! Omuntu akoola endabika ya Maria era n'addamu: —Ani ampita? Naye, omuntu bw'aba nga talina linnya lyonna, olwo tasobola kukola ndabika y'omuntu... Era ebintu bitandika okubula okutuusa omuntu lw'akomawo ng'atalina feesi. Ku bibuuzo bino wammanga, kibuuzo ki omusomesa ky'ayinza okubuuza okukwataganya butereevu ebyasomeddwa n'eddembe erigenda okusomebwa mu kibiina?
answer_a: Kiki ku bikwata ku muwala ali mu lugelo ekikukutte ennyo omwoyo n'olwaki?
answer_b: Kintu ki ku lugelo kyolowooza nti kikwatagana n’eddembe ly’abaana mu lugero luno?
answer_c: Olowooza biki ebiyinza okuvaamu singa omuwala mu lugero talina linnya?
answer_d: Olugero luno luyinza kweyongera lutya okuba n'enkomerero ennungi eri omuwala mu lugero?

question: Omusomesa w'abaana abato, oluvannyuma lw'okukebera okuzuula obuzibu, ateekateeka engeri z'okusomesa ezisobozesa ekibinja ky'abalenzi n'abawala okwogera ku nneewulira zaabwe. Mu ngeri zino wammanga, y'eriwa etuukana n'ekigendererwa ky'omusomesa?
answer_a: Muzannye omuzannyo ogw’ekigambo era musabe abalenzi n’abawala okulaga engeri gye bawulira mu  emboozi gy’ebaleetera.
answer_b: Saba abalenzi n'abawala okujjukira n'okusiiga ebifaananyi by'embeera ezabaleetera engeri yo kuwulira bwebatyo.
answer_c: Muzannye nempulira yo' kufa osabe abalenzi na bawala ba gutuume erinnya erigyamu mumu lamwa.
answer_d: Yita abalenzi n'abawala okuzina, nga bakikirira embeera eyenjawulo geybayogedde mu muzannyo.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina kya ‘kindergarten’ ategese ekibiina mu bifo eby’emizannyo era ng’ayongeddeko ebintu ebipya eby’okukozesa ebisensa, gamba ng’emmeeza z’amazzi, ekitangaala, omusenyu, n’ensigo. Abaana balaze essanyu lingi okuzannya n’ebintu ebipya; kyokka, wabaddewo obutakkaanya wakati waabwe nga babikozesa. Nga tutunuulira omutendera gw’abayizi, engeri ki ku zino wammanga esinga okukulaakulanya obumu mu baana?
answer_a: Omusomesa yeegatta ku mizanyo  gy'abaana ng'ayingira mu kutereeza enkaayana ezibaawo era ng'alaga enkozesa entuufu ey'ebikozesebwa.
answer_b: Omusomesa akolawo akabanga ak’okwogera n’abaana okuzimba endagaano ku ngeri y’okukozesa ebikozesebwa n’okugonjoola enkaayana mu mirembe.
answer_c: Omusomesa assaawo amateeka agafaanagana ku ngeri y’okukozesa ebikozesebwa ebipya mu biseera by’okuzannya era abajjukiza buli kiseera okukutumbula obumu.
answer_d: Omusomesa akola enteekateeka ey’okukyusa ebibinja ng’akozesa ebibinja ebitono eby’abazannyi okwewala enkaayana n’okukutanya emirembe mu banno.

question: Omusomesa omukugu ow’Nasale  alambise ekigendererwa kino okuva ku nsibuko yw’okubaawo n’obutuuze:"Okutegeera ebikolwa ebituufu n’ebikyamu olw’okubeera awamu mu ngeri entuufu mu kibinja, ebyolekeddwa mu mbeera ez’enjawulo ezabulijjo n’emizannyo". Okutuuka ku kino, mu bbanga ly’okwogerezeganya, bateeseteese amateeka agafuga okubeera awamu okuzuula eby’okukola ku buzibu obw’enjawulo obubaawo mu bannaabwe. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyayogerwa?
answer_a: Mu kiseera ky’okwaniriza, omusomesa abuuza ku mateeka, era Rafael agamba: "Olina okutambulira munda mu kibiina so si kudduka."
answer_b: Mu budde bw'emmere, Daniela alya ku mmere ya munne, era akaaba. Ignacia, bw'amulaba nga akaaba, agenda eri omusomesa n'amugamba: "Munnange yeetaaga obuyambi."
answer_c: Mu biseera by’okuzannya , Matías yetegeleza Alejandro ng’azannyisa loole, oluvannyuma n’amusemberera, n’amuggyako eky’okuzannyanyisa n’agamba: “kiseera kyange, omusomesa yagambye tulina okugabana.”
answer_d: Mu biseera by'okukola, Leonor ne Sebastián basuula ebikondo by'emiti okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala mu kibiina. Agustín abasemberera n'abagamba: "Temusaanye kukola ekyo, muyinza okutukuba ebikondo."

question: Bikugu ki obuteekedwateekedwa  mu bawala n'abalenzi okuyita mu mizannyo egikolerwa mu mateeka?
answer_a: Obubonero  bw'embeera ezibaawo mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.
answer_c: Ebintu ebiyamba mu mbeera z'obukulembeze okuli okukkiriziganya n'okukyusakyusa mu mirimu.
answer_d: Okuyiga ebyobulamu obwabulijo  n'obuvunaanyizibwa ebiteekeddwawo mu nsi  saako namateeka
